features.heading: A redesign that modernises the look without losing your traffic

faqs.question: Will a redesign hurt my Google rankings?
faqs.answer: Not when it is done carefully. We map your current URLs, keep your important content, and set up 301 redirects so search engines follow the old pages to their new homes. The goal of the redesign is to hold the rankings you have and improve on them, not reset them to zero.

faqs.question: Can you keep my existing content and branding, or does it all change?
faqs.answer: That is your call. Most clients keep their logo, brand colours, and core content while we modernise the layout, speed, and structure around them. If you want a fuller visual refresh as part of the redesign, we can do that too — we will show you a preview either way before anything goes live.

faqs.question: Will my site go down or be unreachable during the redesign?
faqs.answer: No. We build and test the redesigned version separately, then switch it over once you have approved the preview. Your current site stays live and working the whole time, so there is no gap where visitors hit a broken or empty page.

faqs.question: What if my old site was built on WordPress or a platform I can't easily edit?
faqs.answer: We handle that regularly. We can redesign from your existing WordPress, an old page builder, or a hand-coded site, and move you onto a clean CMS your team can actually update. After launch you own the code, the hosting, and the accounts outright with no lock-in to us.

faqs.question: How do we start, and can I see something before committing?
faqs.answer: Start with a free consultation over WhatsApp where we look at your current site and what is holding it back. Before you commit, we put together a demo preview of the new direction so you can judge the redesign on something real, in both Arabic and English, rather than a promise.
